open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction with store.begin(), which returns a PortalTransaction, read the replay candidate only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo_by_intake_id with publication.intake_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, insert only through tx.progress_photos().insert_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and on success commit exactly once (a replay or a validation failure closes it by rollback instead); it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method. These are ProgressPhotoRepository and ProjectSectionRepository operations; the same-named legacy PortalTransaction methods are never called.
open_points.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise PhotoValidationError when publication.project_id differs from context.project_id before opening any transaction, and when the supplied section is missing or belongs to another project after the scoped read. The transaction guard MUST close its transaction exactly once, roll back on failure only while the transaction is still open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged; substituting a translated persistence error for PhotoValidationError or PhotoConflictError is forbidden.
open_points.question: Must publish_progress_photo open exactly one transaction on every call, or must a project_id mismatch raise before opening any transaction?
